## Limitations recorded in the experiment

- Ideal commutation: commutation current transient and the resulting torque dip are not modelled.
- Averaged PWM, no dead time, switch drops, iron loss or mutual inductance.
- Trapezoid as clipped sine; real back-EMF shapes differ.
- Illustrative parameters; no measured data.
- No hardware validation.
